title: Skill with a scope of both allies and enemies?

posts.author: Ruskah
posts.body:
I want to make a move that can be used on either an ally or an enemy, but there's no scope choice that says "anyone on field" or something like that. I know it can be done in Omori, with pressing a button that switches sides (like when using Sad Poem), so how did they do that?
Thank you to anyone who helps.
